title: Assignment 11 · Contract modifications
summary: Contract modifications. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Alaska Packers’ Association v. Domenico: The fishermen’s promise to perform the same work they already owed did not support a midseason promise to double their fixed compensation.

Watkins & Son v. Carrig: The court enforced a voluntarily agreed higher excavation price even though the original contract already required removal of the rock.

Austin Instrument, Inc. v. Loral Corporation: Loral established economic duress when an indispensable supplier withheld precision gears to extract price increases that Loral could not practicably resist.

Additional assigned materials: Restatement §§ 89, 175, 176; UCC § 2-209; Restatement of Consumer Contracts § 3; N.Y. General Obligations Law § 5-1103.
